import json, re

def extract_text(o):
    msg = o.get('message') or o
    content = msg.get('content') if isinstance(msg, dict) else o.get('content')
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts=[]
        for c in content:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get('type')=='text':
                parts.append(c.get('text') or '')
            elif isinstance(c, dict) and 'text' in c:
                parts.append(c.get('text') or '')
        return '\n'.join(parts)
    return str(content or '')

user_turns=[]
asst_turns=[]
for line in open(p, errors='ignore'):
    try:
        o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    role = (o.get('role') or (o.get('message') or {}).get('role') or '')
    text = extract_text(o)
    m=re.search(r'<timestamp>(.*?)</timestamp>', text)
    ts=m.group(1) if m else ''
    # also look for Nov 19
    uq=re.search(r'<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>', text, re.S)
    body = (uq.group(1).strip() if uq else text.strip())
    if role=='user' or '<user_query>' in text:
        if 'Nov 19' in ts or '2026-11-19' in text[:500] or (not ts and 'Nov 19' in text):
            user_turns.append((ts, body[:500].replace('\n',' | ')))
        elif 'Nov 19' in ts or 'Thursday, Nov 19' in text:
            user_turns.append((ts, body[:500].replace('\n',' | ')))
        # collect all with Nov 19 in timestamp
        if 'Nov 19' in text[:300] or 'Thursday, Nov 19' in text:
            user_turns.append((ts or '?', body[:500].replace('\n',' | ')))
    if role=='assistant' and ('Nov 19' in text[:200] or True):
        # keep last substantial assistant replies that mention completed work keywords on Nov19 context
        pass

# Better: walk all user queries with timestamps
all_u=[]
for line in open(p, errors='ignore'):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    text=extract_text(o)
    if '<user_query>' not in text: continue
    m=re.search(r'<timestamp>(.*?)</timestamp>', text)
    ts=m.group(1) if m else ''
    uq=re.search(r'<user_query>\s*(.*?)\s*</user_query>', text, re.S)
    body=(uq.group(1).strip() if uq else '')[:400].replace('\n',' ')
    all_u.append((ts, body))

print('ALL USER TURNS', len(all_u))
for ts,b in all_u:
    mark='*' if 'Nov 19' in ts else ' '
    print(f'{mark} {ts} :: {b[:220]}')

# extract assistant final-ish replies after Nov 19 turns: find lines after first Nov 19 user
print('\n=== Assistant snippets with 已完成/push/commit/session/影子/挂 ===')
n=0
after=False
for line in open(p, errors='ignore'):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    text=extract_text(o)
    if '<user_query>' in text and 'Nov 19' in text:
        after=True
    if not after: continue
    role=(o.get('role') or (o.get('message') or {}).get('role') or '')
    if role!='assistant': continue
    if any(k in text for k in ['已完成','push','commit','session','影子','挂跑','对账','提审','建表','DDL','ETL','回执','已推','已发']):
        # only text parts, strip tool calls noise
        clean=re.sub(r"\[\{'type': 'tool_use'.*?$", '', text, flags=re.S)
        # get last text block
        texts=re.findall(r"'type': 'text', 'text': '(.*?)'(?=, \{'type':|, \]|})", text, re.S)
        # simpler
        if "'text':" in text and len(text)<5000:
            snippet=text[:600].replace('\n',' ')
        else:
            # try parse content list
            msg=o.get('message') or o
            content=msg.get('content') if isinstance(msg,dict) else None
            snippet=''
            if isinstance(content,list):
                for c in content:
                    if isinstance(c,dict) and c.get('type')=='text':
                        snippet=c.get('text','')[:500]
            else:
                snippet=text[:500]
        if snippet.strip():
            print('-', snippet.replace('\n',' ')[:350])
            n+=1
            if n>=25: break
print('snippets', n)
